questions.question: Does the massing have one clear dominant geometric gesture?
Is the main/support mass hierarchy readable without random fragments?
Does the silhouette avoid relying mainly on stair-step or simple stepback form?
Does the massing use void, courtyard, undercut, or open ground logic in an architecturally meaningful way?
Does the final mass preserve its source geometry after legal repair?
Does the candidate resonate with a recognizable architectural massing principle without copying a precedent?
